snippet.title: (WR) 東方斑桜 (Touhou Ikaruga) Madness/Lunatic ALL - 4.941 Billion pts
snippet.description:
This is pretty much the greatest achievement I’ve ever had at the time I uploaded this run on YT; however, the coming of new scoring strats make me want to replay the game for even higher score someday.

Enjoy this 8 months old unlisted video that just took its first step to the public eyes.
